PrincipalCounts.description:
One principal's requests on one route in one window, as classified by the
operator's own instrumentation: who the bearer token belongs to versus who owns the
requested object, with the business's delegation grants applied (contracts 0.14).

cross_tenant.description: reads of another tenant's object not covered by a grant
cross_tenant.title: Cross Tenant

delegated.description: reads of another tenant's object covered by a grant
delegated.title: Delegated

own.description: every other request (own tenant or no tenant object)
own.title: Own

principal.description: Pseudonymous principal reference chosen by the reporter (e.g. an HMAC of its user id under a key the platform never sees); never an email or raw id
principal.title: Principal

PrincipalCounts.title: PrincipalCounts

description: Aggregated counters for one route over one window (no raw logs, no payloads).

principals.description: optional per-principal counters from a reporter that detects principals
principals.title: Principals

title: RouteWindow
